name: Tapestry
description: Tapestry owns two fashion brands, Coach and kate spade new york, and makes money by selling their handbags, small leather goods, footwear and apparel, about 87 percent of it through its own stores, outlets and websites and the rest to wholesale partners and licensees. Coach is the engine: it was 86.4 percent of FY2026 sales and earned $2.54 billion of segment profit while Kate Spade roughly broke even. Products are made by independent factories (mainly Vietnam, Cambodia, the Philippines, India). Sales were $8.0 billion in FY2026 (+14.2%) with a 77.8 percent gross margin and 23.9 percent operating margin. Stuart Weitzman was sold on 2025-08-04.

businessLines.name: Coach
businessLines.how: Sells Coach-branded handbags and accessories to consumers at full price through its own stores, outlets, concession shops and websites (about 87 percent of company sales are direct-to-consumer), plus wholesale and licensing; margin comes from pricing power on a brand it designs and has made by contract factories.
businessLines.description: Global fashion house of handbags, accessories and lifestyle collections; direct-to-consumer, wholesale and licensing

businessLines.name: Kate Spade
businessLines.how: Same model as Coach (own stores, outlets and websites plus wholesale and licensing) but on a shrinking, lower-margin brand: revenue fell and segment profit was about zero in FY2026.
businessLines.description: Feminine, colourful handbags, ready-to-wear, jewelry, footwear, gifts and home decor under kate spade new york
